card.name: Words inside contraindication and caution lists
card.fires_on: Fires on the word right before a qualifying phrase in contraindication or pregnancy warnings, such as the end of "arrhythmias", "history" or "women". It expects "associated with", "of" or "who" next.

modes.label: Arrhythmias in contraindications
modes.description: The ending "ias" of "arrhythmias" after Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome, before "associated with other cardiac accessory".
modes.example: Frovatriptan succinate is contraindicated in patients with Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome or arrhythm<<ias>> associated with other cardiac accessory conduction pathway

modes.label: History or women before a qualifier
modes.description: "history" or "women" in a contraindication or pregnancy warning, followed by "of" or "who".
modes.example: nursing mothers, or<< women>> who may become pregnant, the possible benefits

modes.label: Partway through drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a drug name in an interaction sentence.
modes.example: decrease glecaprevir and p<<ib>>rentasvir plasma concentrations

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and not informative.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a warning list where a condition or group is about to be narrowed down by a further phrase.
